hero.title: Good trips start with a shared plan.
hero.subtitle: Plan your next India trip with friends. Keep the route, daily plans and shared expenses together, with an AI assistant to help you explore the options.
hero.imageAlt: Legacy OpenTrip example: a five-day Japan itinerary

map.title: The whole trip, on one map.
map.body: Every stop, pinned and numbered. Filter by day, check the forecast, and find that café everyone's been talking about — without leaving the map.
map.imageAlt: Itinerary map with numbered stops and per-day routes

schedule.title: Every day, at a glance.
schedule.body: Keep your stops, travel notes and stays in a day-by-day plan. Check transport times and availability with the provider before you travel.

budget.title: No more awkward math.
budget.body: Record who paid and who shared each expense. Review balances and suggested transfers together. Use one currency per trip while currency-safe accounting is being developed.
budget.imageAlt: Shared expenses with balances and settle-up transfers

agent.title: An AI that knows your trip.
agent.body: “Can we swap day two and three?” Just ask — it proposes the change, and nothing is final until someone on the crew approves.
agent.imageAlt: Trip agent chat suggesting itinerary changes

collaborate.title: Everyone gets a say.
collaborate.body: Invite friends, vote on stops and leave comments. Everyone in the group can return to the same saved itinerary.
collaborate.imageAlt: Stop detail with votes, comments, and costs

mobile.title: The trip goes where you go.
mobile.body: Open your trip on your phone or install the web app. Your itinerary stays close at hand.

cta.title: Your crew is ready when you are.
cta.subtitle: Create a trip with your friends. The current sample is illustrative; Indian demo itineraries and voice planning are in development.

legacyPreview: These captures show the original OpenTrip example. Raahi AI’s India demo and voice workflow are in development.
